about.title: Your Trusted Partner in Vertical Transportation Solutions

paragraph1.before: In a world witnessing rapid urban development and a growing demand for safe and intelligent vertical transportation solutions,
paragraph1.after: has emerged as a distinguished provider of these solutions.

about.paragraph2: Our journey began in Sweden in 2015, where we gained extensive practical experience working with leading global companies such as KONE and Schindler. In 2019, we expanded into the Libyan market and established our headquarters in Libya, bringing with us European technology and international standards.
